feeds.title: Everything Horse | Horse News, Magazine and Classifieds
feeds.description: Everything Horse, the ultimate in equestrian rescourse. Never miss a hoofbeat with the latest horse news

feeds.title: Equestrian Reality
feeds.description: Lets face it when it comes to horses nothing is ever as easy as it seems!

feeds.title: Everything Horse Magazine
feeds.description: Everything Horse is a complete equestrian resource. 1000's of classifieds including horses for sale, horses for loan, tack for sale, equestrian property, horseboxes, and more. The online publication features equestrian news, articles, information, event coverage, product news, competitions, and lots more.

feeds.title: How Very Horsey
feeds.description: Equestrian blog founded by Daisy Smith -Discussing all things horsey including horsemanship, showing and psychology.

feeds.title: Horse & Hound Blog
feeds.description: Weekly equestrian magazine with a popular news website and massive forum community.

feeds.title: Horse Scout Blog
feeds.description: The fastest growing equestrian network. Find exceptional horses for sale, ponies for sale and stallions at stud as well as horse riders, trainers, breeders, race trainers, livery yards and competition yards.

feeds.title: Social Tails
feeds.description: Haynet is a leading equestrian and countryside blogging directory, telling your stories from the stables to the fields. If you love living in the countryside, riding your horse, farming the fields or walking your dogs through the woods then you will feel right at home here!

feeds.title: How to Excel At Being Average
feeds.description: How to Excel At Being Average - a monthly diary of the ups and downs of horse ownership, with Tamasine and Beau Bayou the legend. Riding Club fun and trying to improve - from an 'average' rider!

feeds.title: The Scottish Equestrian Blog
feeds.description: I am UK based rider who very willing to test out products and provide detailed reviews of my mare and I trying out the products. I would like to start competing for my mare and I am on a yard that holds regular competitions for us to enter.

feeds.title: The Integrated Horse | Anni Stonebridge
feeds.description: Blog page for Anni Stonebridge. Rider coach, saddle fitter and equestrian product designer. Co-author of Barefoot Horse Keeping - The integrated horse.

feeds.title: Sarah Lewis Show Jumping | News/Blog
feeds.description: A blog from international show jumper, wife and mother of two fabulous grown-ups, Sarah Lewis. I started this blog hoping to show other ladies of a certain age that when your chicks fly the nest you can grab hold of your life and be whatever you want to be. It is a diary of my days living the dream, and enjoying life to the full

feeds.title: Konna Baza Sakar
feeds.description: Konna Baza Sakar is a horse riding center located in the beautiful and unexplored Sakar Mountain region of southeast Bulgaria. Bulgaria horse riding, horse trekking, horse riding lessons, carriage tours, farm experiences, and rural adventures.

feeds.title: A Country Lady | Equestrian Fashion Blogger
feeds.description: A Country Lady is an Equestrian blog which covers everything from the top of equestrian sports, through to equestrian life, fashion, and fitness. As an amateur Show Jumper myself, I'm obsessed with equestrian fashion. The blog showcases my favorite products along with my equestrian life both the ups and the downs.

feeds.title: Sian Lovatt - Country Bumpkin PR
feeds.description: I am a 26-year-old fully qualified journalist currently working in Marketing. My area of specialty is equestrian journalism however I am also a confident writer in many other areas such as travel, agriculture and more. I have written copy for a number of magazines, newspapers and websites throughout the UK and overseas. When not writing I enjoy competing in British Dressage with my home produced ponies, Ceaser and Ziggy.

feeds.title: Gift Horse Eventing
feeds.description: I've written for and featured in Horse & Hound, Your Horse Magazine, Horse Deals and Vogue Italia, yes Vogue darling! Modelled (I use the term very loosely!) for International equestrian brand Mountain Horse. I've also been part of a charity polo team (after 20 years away from the sport!) and tested my racing skills against professional jockeys).

feeds.title: horseXperiences
feeds.description: The latest equestrian articles and news featuring top stories, favorite destinations, adventures from our guests, and much more. Follow horseXperiences stories and share your love for horses.

feeds.title: Adventures in Black and White
feeds.description: A blog of the ups and downs of an amateur dressage rider with a few guides and reviews thrown in for entertainment. Here, you'll find the day-to-day life of a 9-5 dressage rider, with reviews and updates.

feeds.title: Equipassion UK
feeds.description: Equine and country photographer based near Epsom, Surrey. Sharing my equine passion and spreading happiness through equestrian and country photography.

feeds.title: H&C TV (UK)
feeds.description: Horse & Country TV is a British TV channel about equestrianism and British country lifestyle. H&C TV is broadcast in UK/Ireland on Sky channel 253.

feeds.title: Wimpy Eventer Blog
feeds.description: A diary of the highs and lows of my journey to return to the sport of Eventing. My horse is a Master Imp gelding who enjoys being brushed and doesn't mind me wobbling about!
